name: Banner
overview: The Bible portrays the banner as a powerful symbol of God's presence, protection, and salvation for His people. In Exodus 17:15, Moses names an altar 'Jehovahnissi,' meaning 'The LORD my banner,' emphasizing God's role as a defender and rallying point. Psalms 20:5 and 60:4 depict banners as expressions of rejoicing and a sign of truth for those who fear God. Prophetic passages in Isaiah (5:26; 11:12) describe the banner or ensign as a signal to gather and unite God's people from the nations, underscoring its figurative use as a call to divine gathering and deliverance.
